title: Peer MCP cannot resolve session names beginning with session-
outcome: src/delegation_mcp.rs resolve_session_reference classifies any reference starting with session- as an id and never attempts a name match. A valid root session named session-review therefore cannot be targeted by name even though the tool contract accepts names. Resolve an exact live id first, then fall back to case-insensitive name matching with the existing ambiguity and root/self guards; add regression tests for an id-shaped name.
